texts.562693551ec1: The Speedwell study is one of over 125 prospective cohorts actively involved in the emerging risk factors colaboration (ERFC), a collaborative 'meta-analysis' of anonymised individual participant data from observational studies. This involves pooling proimary data from prospective studies worldwide to help better characterize the age and sex specific associations of cardiovascular disease with several 'emerging risk factors', notably lipid, inflammatory and adiposity markers. The propoesed research will evaluate the usefulness of these emerging risk factors in predicting CVD risk in the general population.
